contributions.metric: Full-evidence policy score of each coalition-selected lineup, evaluated after selection on the frozen full-evidence candidate pool.
contributions.scope: Internal decision attribution only; not causal cultural impact, audience preference, attendance or sales uplift.

human.reason: No independent blinded review study is linked to this experiment.

independentOutcomes.reason: No linked held-out post-event audience preference or ticket outcome is available for this comparison.

decisionDifference.scoreComparisonCaveat: Scores use different evidence availability. Their difference is a policy diagnostic, not causal uplift.

sharedFinancialAssumptions.financialScenario: not linked; the fee difference is not a profit or revenue difference

decisionDifference.interpretation: Observed optimizer selection change under withdrawn evidence. Linked receipts identify evidence to inspect, not proven causal market uplift.

weightSensitivity.interpretation: Discrete preference sensitivity of the full-versus-no-evidence selection. These weights express organizer values, not empirical probabilities.

limitations: The fixed candidate pool may itself include Qloo-discovered artists; this experiment does not test independent discovery.
Cultural policy scores and Shapley contributions are in-sample decision diagnostics, not independent booking quality or causal impact.
Illustrative fees and missing external judgments cannot establish commercial superiority.
The four methods share the declared operational policy; changed fit-floor policy is recorded explicitly.
Provider costs and end-to-end research latency are unavailable unless captured by the source benchmark receipts.

contributions.metric: Full-evidence policy score of each coalition-selected lineup, evaluated after selection on the frozen full-evidence candidate pool.
contributions.scope: Internal decision attribution only; not causal cultural impact, audience preference, attendance or sales uplift.

human.reason: No independent blinded review study is linked to this experiment.

independentOutcomes.reason: No linked held-out post-event audience preference or ticket outcome is available for this comparison.

decisionDifference.scoreComparisonCaveat: Scores use different evidence availability. Their difference is a policy diagnostic, not causal uplift.

sharedFinancialAssumptions.financialScenario: not linked; the fee difference is not a profit or revenue difference

decisionDifference.interpretation: Observed optimizer selection change under withdrawn evidence. Linked receipts identify evidence to inspect, not proven causal market uplift.

weightSensitivity.interpretation: Discrete preference sensitivity of the full-versus-no-evidence selection. These weights express organizer values, not empirical probabilities.

limitations: The fixed candidate pool may itself include Qloo-discovered artists; this experiment does not test independent discovery.
Cultural policy scores and Shapley contributions are in-sample decision diagnostics, not independent booking quality or causal impact.
Illustrative fees and missing external judgments cannot establish commercial superiority.
The four methods share the declared operational policy; changed fit-floor policy is recorded explicitly.
Provider costs and end-to-end research latency are unavailable unless captured by the source benchmark receipts.

pairedBookingCost.unit: Full HouseLights quoted fees minus saved LLM quoted fees; comparisons stay within each currency.

summary.limitation: The event brief is the unit; repeated model attempts must not be counted as independent markets. The LLM failure fraction counts available saved attempts, and repeatedBriefs exposes clustering. Operational outcomes do not prove audience preference.

limitations: Published records can repeat event briefs and artist pools; independent coverage is the distinct-brief and distinct-pool count.
No reviewer preference or observed sales outcome is supplied by this case manifest.
Published illustrative booking terms cannot validate commercial impact.
